applicabilityBasis.summary: Token Teknoloji markets EUROT as a 1:1 euro-backed stablecoin intended to facilitate euro transactions and 24/7 trading, making it an apparent payment stablecoin despite its Turkish issuer and unresolved U.S. posture.

references.label: Token Teknoloji EUROT product page

genius.notes: As of 2026-10-07, no token-specific U.S. GENIUS authorization, official application or registered foreign-issuer exception was found in the reviewed public sources. The issuer describes euro backing and conversion through Bitlo; no contractual direct par-redemption policy or publicly available monthly attestation was located. A conflicting FAQ line refers to Turkish-lira reserves, while the product description and reserve table refer to euro backing; this disclosure inconsistency remains unresolved. Reserve letters shown are dated 2024 and do not establish current reserve adequacy. The Turkish SPK lists Token Teknoloji AŞ among firms not continuing crypto-asset service-provider activity; that domestic list does not establish a U.S. GENIUS enforcement finding or token redemption failure. The Act remains pre-effective, with January 18, 2027 expected; foreign qualification remains unknown.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public token-specific PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, regulator-confirmed pending application, registered foreign-issuer exception, or U.S. GENIUS enforcement action was located for Token Teknoloji A.Ş. or EUROT in these reviewed sources as of 2026-10-07. Exact-name searches produced no matching official authorization. Proposed federal implementation rules and the SCRC procedural rule do not establish issuer approval or an earlier Act effective date. The public-source review is not a claim that no private application exists.
